plugins.name: searchfit-seo
plugins.description: Free AI-powered SEO toolkit — audit websites, plan content strategy, optimize pages, generate schema markup, cluster keywords, and track AI visibility. Works with any website or codebase.

skills.name: ai-visibility
skills.description: Analyze and improve how a brand appears in AI-generated responses (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity). Use when the user asks about "AI visibility", "AI tracking", "how does my brand appear in AI", "AI mentions", "LLM visibility", "AI search optimization", "GEO", "generative engine optimization", "answer engine optimization", "AEO", or wants their brand to be recommended by AI assistants.
skills.description_zh: 分析并改善品牌在 ChatGPT、Claude、Gemini和 Perplexity等 AI回答中的出现、提及和推荐情况，适用于 GEO、AEO及模型可见性跟踪。

skills.name: broken-links
skills.description: Find and fix broken links on a website or in a codebase. Use when the user asks to "check broken links", "find dead links", "fix 404s", "link checker", "broken link audit", "find dead URLs", or wants to identify and repair links that lead to non-existent pages.
skills.description_zh: 查找和修复网站或代码库指向不存在页面的链接，支持失效 URL、404和断链审计。

skills.name: content-brief
skills.description: Generate a detailed content brief for a specific article or page. Use when the user asks to "create a content brief", "write a brief", "article outline", "blog brief", "writing brief", "content outline", or wants a structured plan before writing content.
skills.description_zh: 为指定文章或页面生成详细内容简报与结构化写作提纲，在撰稿前明确计划。

skills.name: content-strategy
skills.description: Develop a content strategy for SEO and organic growth. Use when the user asks to "plan content", "content strategy", "content calendar", "what should I write about", "content gap analysis", "topic research", "editorial plan", or wants to plan what content to create for their website.
skills.description_zh: 为网站 SEO和自然增长制定内容策略、主题研究、缺口分析、编辑日历及选题计划。

skills.name: content-translation
skills.description: Translate and localize website content for international SEO. Use when the user asks to "translate content", "localize my site", "multilingual SEO", "translate to [language]", "international SEO", "hreflang", "multi-language website", or wants to expand content to new languages and markets.
skills.description_zh: 面向国际 SEO翻译与本地化网站内容，支持多语言、hreflang及新语言市场扩展。

skills.name: internal-linking
skills.description: Analyze and improve internal linking strategy for a website. Use when the user asks about "internal links", "link structure", "site architecture", "link strategy", "orphan pages", "link equity", "page authority distribution", or wants to improve how pages connect to each other.
skills.description_zh: 分析并改善网站内链结构、页面连接、孤立页、链接权重与页面权威分配。

skills.name: keyword-clustering
skills.description: Cluster and organize keywords into topical groups for SEO. Use when the user asks to "cluster keywords", "group keywords", "organize keywords", "keyword mapping", "topic clusters", "keyword grouping", or has a list of keywords they want structured into a content plan.
headings: Step 3: Cluster by Search Intent & Topic
skills.description_zh: 将关键词按主题分组、映射并组织为 SEO内容计划。

skills.name: on-page-seo
skills.description: Optimize a specific page for on-page SEO. Use when the user asks to "optimize this page", "improve SEO for this page", "on-page optimization", "optimize meta tags", "improve rankings for [keyword]", or wants to make a specific page rank better.
skills.description_zh: 优化指定页面的页内 SEO、元标签及目标关键词排名表现。

skills.name: schema-markup
skills.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data / schema markup for web pages. Use when the user asks to "add schema", "generate JSON-LD", "structured data", "schema markup", "rich snippets", "add schema.org", or wants to improve how their pages appear in search results.
skills.description_zh: 为网页生成 JSON-LD和 schema.org结构化数据，支持富摘要和搜索展示优化。

skills.name: seo-audit
skills.description: Run a comprehensive SEO audit on a website or codebase. Use when the user asks to "audit SEO", "check my site's SEO", "find SEO issues", "SEO health check", "technical SEO review", "site audit", or wants to identify SEO problems on their website.
headings: If the user has a codebase open:
If the user provides a URL:
skills.description_zh: 对网站或代码库执行全面 SEO审计，识别健康、技术和其他搜索优化问题。

skills.name: technical-seo
skills.description: Perform a technical SEO audit on a website or codebase. Use when the user asks for "technical SEO", "site speed", "core web vitals", "crawlability", "indexation issues", "robots.txt", "sitemap check", "render blocking", "page speed", "mobile-friendly check", or wants to fix technical factors affecting search rankings.
skills.description_zh: 审计网站技术 SEO，包括速度、核心 Web指标、抓取、索引、robots、站点地图、渲染阻塞和移动适配。

commands.name: create-content
commands.description: Generate SEO-optimized content for a specific topic or keyword. Creates a full article with title, meta description, headings, body, internal links, and schema markup.

commands.name: create-topic
commands.description: Research and generate a complete topic plan with keyword mapping, content angle, audience targeting, and competitive positioning. Use before writing content to ensure you're targeting the right topic the right way.

commands.name: generate-schema
commands.description: Generate JSON-LD structured data / schema markup for a page. Outputs ready-to-paste schema based on the page content.

commands.name: keyword-cluster
commands.description: Cluster a list of keywords into topical groups mapped to content pages. Paste or provide keywords and get organized clusters with content recommendations.

commands.name: seo-check
commands.description: Quick SEO check on the current file or page. Instantly evaluates title, meta, headings, images, and structured data for SEO best practices.

commands.name: translate-content
commands.description: Translate and localize content for international SEO. Translates with keyword research, hreflang tags, and cultural adaptation — not just word-for-word translation.
